title: Subscription panel shows what’s actually active
summary:
Enter got a clearer subscription panel and a home for its terms and privacy documents, with some quieter web plumbing alongside.

Enter now separates an assigned tier from an active Polar subscription. The panel shows the active product and daily Pollen, offers activation when a tier is assigned but no subscription is active, and counts down to refills in 24-hour cycles from subscription start.

Enter gained a /terms page with separate Terms of Service and Privacy Policy documents. The dashboard links to it, and the main site’s footer now points there too.

Enter’s Pollen FAQ now renders from Markdown. Image and text upstream URLs were updated to their origin hosts, image proxy error logging was added, and a missing comma in the main site’s creative projects list was fixed.
